name: Герои Эхо недели саганов — народ пепельных равнин, отбивший нашествие Ицаля «Ночь падающих солнц» (ADR-0023, ADR-0024; docs/content/герои/состав-героев.md, «Саганы — Ицаль»; RS.weeks в design/ui/roster.js). Пятеро по герою за цикл II–VI: c2-52 Олтика Мокрая Глина, c3-49 Ийяна Пепельная Вода, c4-53 Шалько Зеркальщик, c5-59 Кацтль Холодный Ветер, c6-53 Минке Базальт. Задание 30.09.2026: портреты для окон призыва и Эхо вместо инициалов. Рецепт — принятый отряд Иш-Кантуна (jobs/heroes-echo-ishkantun.json) и способ «Глубокий промт персонажа» (art/style/style.md); в рамке — нижний край режет фигуру по поясу и внизу ничего не написано. Раса — Забытые, облик ни на кого из нынешних не похож. Народ пепельных равнин — решение агента по главам: сухие и жилистые, глаза бледного льда, кожа цвета остывшего базальта с голубизной, волосы от природы пепельно-белые; серый хлопок, базальт, обсидиан, волокно, глина; холод дороже воды, вода дороже всего. Враги недели — саганы Ицаля, живой огонь в корке угля и обсидиана, зеркала, солнечные диски, пернатые огненные змеи (jobs/echo-itsal.json) — только трофеи и угроза за правым краем. Класс — по оружию и действию, школа — по цвету света. Детали, которых нет в «кто он» и главах, — решение агента, по строке в source
style: Art style: hand-painted stylized dark-fantasy game art for a mobile RPG. Painterly digital illustration with visible, confident brush strokes and simplified planar shapes, crisp rim light on edges, strong readable silhouettes, deep near-black shadows. Epic, heroic character art: a powerful pose, a low camera, strong light from below. Light tells the story: a few strong sources — crystals and cracks that glow from within — throw colored light upward, the light comes from below. Cold and warm light contrast. Dust motes and grains of sand float in the light. Moderate detail, clean readable forms; the face, the hands and the weapon get the most detail. No photorealism, no 3D-render look, no anime. Match the brushwork, lighting and color handling of the attached style reference images, but do NOT copy their subjects, objects, letters or composition.
negative: No text, no letters, no numbers, no real-world alphabets, no runes or markings that look like writing, no glyphs, no watermark, no signature, no logo, no UI elements, no border or frame around the picture, no name plate, no gems or badges of rank. No bodies, no skulls, no blood. Only one character in the foreground; a person has exactly two arms and two hands. Not stiff, not passive, not posing like a mannequin; no empty eyes. The hero is flesh and blood, not a being of fire: no glowing cracks in the hero's skin, no flames for hair, no gold sun disc on the hero. No jade, no stepped pyramids.

heroes.frame:
Draw exactly one image in a single pass: no alternative versions, no second attempts, no text in the reply. Format: vertical hero card portrait, 4:5. A close, heroic half-body portrait from the waist or hips up, three-quarter view: the bottom edge of the picture cuts the body at the belt or the hips; no knees, no legs, no feet in the frame, whatever the pose. The camera is a little below the hero's chest and looks slightly up, so the hero towers — a legend, not an extra. The hero's body is turned toward the right side of the picture, toward unseen enemies beyond the right edge, and the face is seen in three-quarter view looking to the right. The hero is caught at the peak of an action that shows who they are; the pose carries weight and intent. Head in the upper third, the face large, well lit and readable at small size, with a clear expression; the lower quarter may be darker because the card puts the name there, but nothing is written there. Rich atmospheric background that tells where the hero lived, with depth and soft focus, darker than the character. Light comes from below and from glowing crystals; rim light separates the figure from the background.

The hero belongs to the people of the ash plains — a forgotten people who lived long before all the peoples of today, on wide plains of grey ash and black basalt, where cold is more precious than water and water is more precious than anything. They look unlike any people living now: lean and sinewy, long-limbed, with long faces, sharp cheekbones and narrow, heavy-lidded eyes of pale ice-grey; their skin is dark slate-grey with a cool bluish undertone, like cooled basalt; their hair is naturally ash-white, cropped short or worn in short thick locks tied with grey cord. They wear loose wraps and hooded mantles of undyed grey cotton and pale woven fibre and cords of grey stone beads; their tools are black basalt, grey stone, obsidian flakes, woven fibre and fired clay. Their enemies were the people of Itsal — beings of living fire held in a human-like shape, their bodies a crust of cracked charcoal and obsidian with orange-gold fire glowing through every crack, with gold sun discs and polished black obsidian mirrors, feathered serpents of flame and dogs of smouldering coal; on the Night of the Falling Suns they came down from their cities of black mirrors to warm themselves with the warmth of others; such things appear only as trophies or as the threat beyond the right edge.

jobs.title: Олтика Мокрая Глина — Забытые, танк, Вода (c2-52, Эхо, эпическая)
jobs.source: roster.js c2-52: «Обмазывалась мокрой глиной и шла прямо в огонь Ицаля: глина держала жар дольше, чем кожа»; глава «Мокрая глина»: первое солнце упало на селение; вынесла пятерых; огненный змей сказал «Здесь тепло»; в шестой раз глина высохла раньше, чем она дошла обратно. Решение агента: шаг в горящий проём плечом вперёд, рука в мокрой глине отводит горящую балку, пар; кувшин воды за спиной; змей из пламени над крышей — только перья огня за краем. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c2-52-oltika__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c2-52.jpg. v2: v1 не выдана моделью (IMAGE_SAFETY) — видимо, «обмазалась глиной с головы до ног» и люди в огне; теперь мокрая глина на плаще, руках и волосах, и она держит горящую балку в дверях
jobs.subject: Subject: Oltika Wet-Clay, a woman of the ash plains, a defender of the Water school. Who she is: when the first falling sun struck her village and the fiery ones came out of it to warm themselves, she knew clay: wet clay holds off heat longer than skin. She wrapped herself in a long grey mantle soaked through and thickly coated with wet clay, coated her arms and hair with it, and went into the fire again and again to lead her neighbours out of the burning houses. Right now she shields the doorway of a burning house with her own body. Character: fearless, stubborn and fiercely protective; her jaw set, her pale ice-grey eyes blazing, her whole body leaning into the heat. Pose, the moment of the shield: the camera is low; she stands in a burning doorway, turned toward the right, her shoulder forward. She has exactly two arms: her near arm is raised in front of her, the forearm thick with wet grey clay, holding up a heavy burning beam that is falling from the right, and a sheath of cool blue water-light of the Water school clings to the clay and hisses against the flames; her far hand holds the edge of her clay-soaked mantle spread wide behind her like a wall. White steam bursts from the clay. Details that tell her story: (1) she wears a long hooded mantle of grey cloth, soaked and thick with wet clay, cracking at the edges where it dries; (2) white steam rises wherever the fire touches the clay; (3) a big clay jar of water is slung across her back; (4) her ash-white hair is caked into thick clay locks; (5) above the burning roof beyond the right edge only fiery feathers of flame are seen. Place: a village of low stone and fibre houses on the ash plain at night, a fallen sun blazing on the horizon, ash falling like black snow. Cool blue light of the Water school glows from the wet clay and from a spilled puddle below; the fire throws hot orange light from the right.

jobs.title: Ийяна Пепельная Вода — Забытые, лекарь, Вода (c3-49, Эхо, уникальная)
jobs.source: roster.js c3-49: «Лекарка пепельных равнин. Остужала ожоги водой с пеплом — тем самым пеплом, что оставлял огонь Ицаля»; главы «Вода с пеплом» (пепел в воде, если дать отстояться, делает воду мягкой и холодной, как в глубоком колодце; белый пепел огненных лечит лучше), «Ожоги» (к огню с той ночи не подходила; последний день — угольные псы у навеса). Решение агента: миг лечения — струя молочной холодной воды из кувшина вправо, пар холода; ряды кувшинов с отстаивающимся пеплом под навесом; спиной к зареву. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c3-49-iyana__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c3-49.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Iyana Ash-Water, a woman of the ash plains, a healer of the Water school. Who she is: a burn is healed with cold, but on the ash plains cold must first be found; she found it in ash — ash stirred into water and left to settle makes the water soft and cold, like water from a deep well. The white ash that the fiery ones left behind healed best of all — the first bitterness of that night. Right now the burned are carried to her shelter, and she pours cold ash-water. Character: steady, bitter and tireless — a healer who has not stepped near a fire since that night; her face grave and tight, her eyes fixed on the burn she is cooling. Pose, the moment of healing: the camera is low; she stands under a low awning of woven fibre, turned toward the right, leaning forward. She has exactly two arms: her near arm tips a wide clay jar, and a stream of pale, milky, glowing cold ash-water pours out toward the right onto the burned beyond the right edge, cool mist rolling off it; her far hand holds a wet cloth ready. Cool blue light of the Water school shines through the stream. Details that tell her story: (1) her arms are grey with ash to the elbows; (2) rows of clay jars stand behind her, the ash settling in them; (3) soaked cloths hang drying on the poles of the awning; (4) a string of grey stone beads is wound around her wrist; (5) her back is turned to the red glow of a fallen sun on the horizon. Place: her shelter on the ash plain in a night without day: ash falling like snow, a dull red glow under a sky black with smoke. Blue light rises from the jars and the wet ground below.

jobs.title: Шалько Зеркальщик — Забытые, контроль (на дебаффы), Земля (c4-53, Эхо, древняя)
jobs.source: roster.js c4-53: «Бил обсидиановые зеркала жрецов Ицаля. Разбитое зеркало не отражало солнце, и огонь не находил цели»; главы «Обсидиан» (колол ножи; цель огню показывает зеркало), «Разбитое зеркало» (бить в середину, наискось, где обсидиан помнит, что был огнём; руки в порезах до локтей; жалости не было), «Солнце без отражения». Решение агента: удар базальтовым клином в зеркало у правого края — зеркало рассыпается, солнечный огонь в нём гаснет; ожерелье из своих обсидиановых ножей. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c4-53-shalko__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c4-53.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Shalko the Mirror-Breaker, a man of the ash plains, a controller of the Earth school who cripples his foes. Who he is: he chipped knives from black obsidian and knew where to strike it so that it split evenly or shattered. The priests of Itsal wore obsidian mirrors so polished that they caught the sun and gave its fire to a target — their fire does not seek a target by itself, the mirror shows it the way. He followed the priests across the ash with a stone wedge and broke their mirrors: in the middle, slantwise, where obsidian remembers it was once fire. Right now a fire priest raises a mirror full of burning sunlight at him. Character: hard, precise and pitiless — he does not pity a single one of them; his mouth a thin line, his narrow eyes cold and fixed on one point. Pose, the moment of the blow: the camera is low; he lunges toward the right, his whole weight behind the strike. He has exactly two arms: his near hand drives a pointed wedge of black basalt, gripped like a dagger, slantwise into the middle of a large round obsidian mirror at the right edge of the picture; the mirror shatters into a burst of black glass shards, and the sunfire caught in it dies out; his far hand is drawn back, clenched, for balance. Amber-orange light of the Earth school flashes at the point of impact. Details that tell his story: (1) his forearms are crossed with dozens of fine cuts from obsidian shards, up to the elbows; (2) a belt of stone wedges and knapping tools; (3) a necklace of small black obsidian knives he chipped himself; (4) black shards glitter in the air around him; (5) ash in his cropped white hair. Place: the ash plain in a night without day, burning suns falling in the smoky sky, the black mirror towers of Itsal far away. Amber light rises from cracks in the basalt below; the mirror's fire is dying at the right edge.

jobs.title: Кацтль Холодный Ветер — Забытые, маг ДД, Воздух (c5-59, Эхо, древняя)
jobs.source: roster.js c5-59: «Заклинатель ветра пепельных равнин. Гнал холодный ветер навстречу падающим солнцам и гасил их одно за другим»; главы «Холодный ветер» (живёт в расщелинах базальта, зовут тишиной; ложился на плечи, как плащ), «Падающие солнца» (трескались губы), «Пепел в небе» (ветер жил в нём, как второе горло; горло, сожжённое ветром — в главе Ийяны), «Четвёртое солнце». Решение агента: миг заклинания на базальтовом гребне — ледяной бело-зелёный вихрь вправо, в падающее солнце; иней на пальцах и бровях; шрам ожога на горле. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c5-59-kaztl__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c5-59.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Katztl Cold-Wind, a man of the ash plains, a battle mage of the Air school. Who he is: his people said the cold wind lives in the cracks of the basalt and comes out if you call it with what it wants — silence. He called it for whole nights, and it lay on his shoulders like a cloak. On the Night of the Falling Suns he drove the cold wind against the falling suns and put them out one after another, until the wind no longer went back into the cracks and lived in him like a second throat. Right now the fourth sun is falling toward him. Character: severe, ascetic and unyielding — a quiet man turned into a storm; his lips cracked and white with frost, his narrow eyes blazing pale, his long face drawn and fierce. Pose, the moment of the spell: the camera is low; he stands on a ridge of black basalt, turned toward the right, leaning into the blast. He has exactly two arms: both arms are thrust forward toward the right, palms open, and a vast torrent of icy white-green wind pours past him toward a burning sun beyond the right edge; the flames bend back and gutter out into grey smoke (Air). His mantle and cropped white hair are torn backward by the wind; frost forms on his fingers. Details that tell his story: (1) his lips are cracked and rimed with frost; (2) frost crystals on his brows and eyelashes; (3) a pale burn scar across his throat; (4) a long mantle of grey fibre that billows like wings; (5) cold white mist seeps up from the cracks of the basalt around him. Place: a basalt ridge above the ash plain in a night without day: a great sun falling from a sky black with ash, embers swirling. Pale white-green light of the Air school rises from the cracks of the basalt below; the hot orange of the falling sun comes from the right.

jobs.title: Минке Базальт — Забытые, физ ДД силы, Земля (c6-53, Эхо, вневременная)
jobs.source: roster.js c6-53: «Камнетёс пепельных равнин с базальтовым молотом. Разбивал огненных змей на искры, которые гасли в пепле»; главы «Базальтовый молот» (базальт — самый холодный камень; молот тяжёлый, как упрямство; тёплый камень лжёт, холодный говорит правду), «Огненный змей» (ударил по голове — рассыпался искрами), «Искры в пепле», «Пятое солнце» (поднялся на базальтовый гребень и бил, пока базальт не раскалился в руках), «Холодный камень». Решение агента: удар молотом сверху по голове пернатого змея у правого края; край бойка раскалён; ладони в волдырях. К выгрузке — art/generated/heroes/hero-c6-53-minke__nb2.jpg → design/ui/assets/art/heroes/c6-53.jpg
jobs.subject: Subject: Minke Basalt, a man of the ash plains, a warrior of great strength of the Earth school. Who he is: a stonecutter who hewed millstones and thresholds out of basalt — the coldest stone, which was fire so long ago that it has forgotten; his hammer was basalt too, heavy as stubbornness. A stonecutter listens to stone with his palm: warm stone lies, cold stone tells the truth. He smashed the feathered fire serpents of Itsal into sparks that died in the ash, and when the fifth and last sun hung over the plain, he climbed to it himself, onto the basalt ridge where the stone is coldest, and struck until the basalt glowed red in his hands. Right now a feathered serpent of flame lunges at him. Character: stubborn, massive and unshakable — slow to anger and impossible to stop; his heavy brows knotted, his jaw clenched, his pale eyes cold as his stone. Pose, the moment of the blow: the camera is low; he towers on a basalt ridge, turned toward the right, his torso arched back and twisted. He has exactly two arms: both hands swing a huge hammer of black basalt, bound to a heavy wooden haft with rawhide, from high above his head down toward the right onto the burning head of a feathered serpent at the right edge of the picture; the serpent bursts into a shower of sparks. The hammer head is large and close to the camera near the top of the picture; amber-orange light of the Earth school flashes where it strikes. Details that tell his story: (1) the basalt hammer head is chipped and dark, glowing red along one edge from the blows; (2) his palms are blistered and wrapped in strips of grey cloth; (3) sparks die into grey ash around him; (4) his broad bare shoulders are streaked with ash; (5) a stonecutter's chisel and a small maul hang from his belt. Place: the high basalt ridge under the last, great fifth sun hanging low in a sky black with smoke; the ash plain far below. Amber light rises from the cracks of the basalt below; the sun's hot light rims him from the right.
